text: 57-year-old male. The patient reports a large wound on his right lower leg that has been present for 6 months. speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Venous Insufficiency with Venous Stasis Ulcer.

The history of a DVT 5 years ago, combined with a 10-year history of bilateral leg swelling and a strong family history, strongly suggests venous insufficiency as the underlying cause. Can you describe the appearance of the wound (e.g., location on the leg, shape, and base characteristics) and any associated symptoms like itching or heaviness?
